WITH legislators_first_term AS (
    SELECT 
        lt.id_bioguide,
        l.gender,
        MIN(lt.term_start) as first_term_start,
        COUNT(*) as total_terms
    FROM city_legislation.main.legislators l
    JOIN city_legislation.main.legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    GROUP BY lt.id_bioguide, l.gender
),
legislators_serving_dec31 AS (
    SELECT 
        lt.id_bioguide,
        l.gender,
        MIN(lt.term_start) as first_term_start,
        COUNT(*) as total_terms,
        -- Check if serving on Dec 31 of each year
        CASE 
            WHEN lt.term_start <= '1990-12-31' AND lt.term_end >= '1990-12-31' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as serving_1990,
        CASE 
            WHEN lt.term_start <= '1992-12-31' AND lt.term_end >= '1992-12-31' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as serving_1992,
        CASE 
            WHEN lt.term_start <= '1994-12-31' AND lt.term_end >= '1994-12-31' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as serving_1994,
        CASE 
            WHEN lt.term_start <= '1996-12-31' AND lt.term_end >= '1996-12-31' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as serving_1996,
        CASE 
            WHEN lt.term_start <= '1998-12-31' AND lt.term_end >= '1998-12-31' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as serving_1998,
        CASE 
            WHEN lt.term_start <= '2000-12-31' AND lt.term_end >= '2000-12-31' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as serving_2000
    FROM city_legislation.main.legislators l
    JOIN city_legislation.main.legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    GROUP BY lt.id_bioguide, l.gender, MIN(lt.term_start)
)
SELECT 
    id_bioguide,
    gender,
    first_term_start,
    total_terms,
    serving_1990,
    serving_1992,
    serving_1994,
    serving_1996,
    serving_1998,
    serving_2000
FROM legislators_serving_dec31
ORDER BY first_term_start
LIMIT 10

        lt.id_bioguide,
        l.gender,
        lt.term_start,
        lt.term_end,
        -- Check if serving on Dec 31 of each year
        CASE 
            WHEN lt.term_start <= '1990-12-31' AND lt.term_end >= '1990-12-31' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as serving_1990,
        CASE 
            WHEN lt.term_start <= '1992-12-31' AND lt.term_end >= '1992-12-31' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as serving_1992,
        CASE 
            WHEN lt.term_start <= '1994-12-31' AND lt.term_end >= '1994-12-31' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as serving_1994,
        CASE 
            WHEN lt.term_start <= '1996-12-31' AND lt.term_end >= '1996-12-31' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as serving_1996,
        CASE 
            WHEN lt.term_start <= '1998-12-31' AND lt.term_end >= '1998-12-31' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as serving_1998,
        CASE 
            WHEN lt.term_start <= '2000-12-31' AND lt.term_end >= '2000-12-31' THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END as serving_2000
    FROM city_legislation.main.legislators l
    JOIN city_legislation.main.legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
),
legislators_first_term AS (
    SELECT 
        id_bioguide,
        gender,
        MIN(term_start) as first_term_start,
        COUNT(*) as total_terms
    FROM legislators_terms_with_serving
    GROUP BY id_bioguide, gender
),
legislators_serving_dec31 AS (
    SELECT 
        ltws.id_bioguide,
        ltws.gender,
        MIN(ltws.term_start) as first_term_start,
        COUNT(*) as total_terms,
        SUM(ltws.serving_1990) as serving_1990,
        SUM(ltws.serving_1992) as serving_1992,
        SUM(ltws.serving_1994) as serving_1994,
        SUM(ltws.serving_1996) as serving_1996,
        SUM(ltws.serving_1998) as serving_1998,
        SUM(ltws.serving_2000) as serving_2000
    FROM legislators_terms_with_serving ltws
    JOIN legislators_first_term ltft ON ltws.id_bioguide = ltft.id_bioguide AND ltws.gender = ltft.gender
    GROUP BY ltws.id_bioguide, ltws.gender, MIN(ltws.term_start)
)
SELECT 
    id_bioguide,
    gender,
    first_term_start,
    total_terms,
    serving_1990,
    serving_1992,
    serving_1994,
    serving_1996,
    serving_1998,
    serving_2000
FROM legislators_serving_dec31
ORDER BY first_term_start
LIMIT 10
